name: LEP Point 4 (ALEPH cavern)
notes: Point number is directly sourced ('Located at point 4 of the LEP ring', CERN Courier ALEPH page); coordinates are an OpenStreetMap/Nominatim centroid for the surface marker 'CERN - Point 4', by the same method already used elsewhere in this atlas for site:cern-point-1-atlas. REVIEW REQUIRED (A17): no official CERN or geodetic publication giving surveyed coordinates for this cavern was fetched in this session.

summary.plain: The underground cavern at Point 4 of the LEP ring, near the French village of Echenevex, where the ALEPH detector recorded electron-positron collisions from 1989 to 2000.
summary.technical: LEP interaction point 4, in the commune of Echenevex (Ain, France); housed the ALEPH detector for the full LEP programme. The same tunnel point today carries only accelerating RF equipment for the LHC, not a detector.
